unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning LLMs on human rater scores to automate scoring of open-ended psychological assessment responses
Testing generalization of fine-tuned scoring models to an independent nonclinical dataset

screen.reason: The study evaluates fine-tuned large language models for automated scoring of a clinical psychological questionnaire (AIHQ) using retrospective data from TBI patients and controls, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
